settings.title: Important Note Before Buying a MagSafe Stand
settings.content:
This MagSafe Phone Stand is designed to work only with MagSafe-compatible iPhone cases.

To ensure full magnetic strength and optimal performance, please use it with a genuine MagSafe-enabled case.

✅ Buying with our MagSafe Phone Case?

Great choice! When purchased together, the finish of the phone stand (Glossy or Matte) will be automatically matched to your selected phone case — ensuring a seamless, unified look in both texture and design.

📝 Purchasing the stand alone, or want a different finish than your case?

No problem — just leave a note at checkout or email us after placing your order to specify your preferred finish.

For example, if your case is Glossy but you prefer a Matte stand, we’ll be happy to accommodate your request!

settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.content:
Order Processing:

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. A tracking number will be provided via email once your order has been shipped.

Shipping Locations:

We ship worldwide! No matter where you are, we’ll deliver to your doorstep. Shipping times may vary depending on your country.

Free Shipping:

Enjoy free shipping on all orders with 2 or more items, anywhere in the world — no minimum spend required.

Delays:

Please note that shipping times may be delayed during holidays or due to unforeseen circumstances. We recommend placing orders early to ensure timely delivery.

Package Tracking:

Once your order is dispatched, you’ll receive a tracking number to monitor your package on the carrier’s website or directly through our store.

settings.title: Return Policy
settings.content:
Return Policy
  • Returns are accepted only if you received the wrong model or design.
  • Items must be unused, unworn, with tags, and in original packaging.
  • Proof of purchase is required.
  • Returns for other reasons (e.g., change of mind) are not accepted.
How to Return
  • Contact us at support_agent@caseease.com with your order details and reason.
  • Once approved, we will send you a return label and instructions.
  • Please return the item within 7 days of approval.
  • Unauthorized returns will not be accepted.
Refunds
  • Refunds are processed after we receive and inspect the returned item.
  • Approved refunds will be issued within 10 business days to your original payment method.
  • If you haven’t received your refund within 15 business days, please contact us.
Return Shipping Costs
  • We cover return shipping for wrong or defective items.
  • For other returns, customers pay the return shipping cost.
Refund Processing Fees
  • Refunds are subject to a non-refundable processing fee based on order status:
  • Within 2 hours of order: Free
  • Order not yet in production: $2
  • Order in production but not shipped: $3
Note
  • Orders cannot be cancelled or refunded after shipping, except for defective or incorrect items.

For full details, please refer to our complete Return & Refund Policy page.

settings.heading: Reviews
settings.recommendation_text: of reviewers would recommend this product to a friend.
settings.summary_note:
Customers say this TPU + PC case feels sturdy, comfortable, and protective without being too bulky. The dual-layer design gives the phone a solid, secure feel, while the soft TPU edges make it easy to grip and comfortable to hold every day.

Many customers appreciate the precise fit, responsive buttons, and clean cutouts that make the case easy to use. The hard PC back helps keep the design looking crisp, while the shock-absorbing TPU frame adds extra protection against daily drops, bumps, and scratches.

Users also like that the case feels lightweight compared with many heavy-duty cases, making it practical for everyday use. Common feedback includes the case’s smooth finish, reliable protection, and stylish look. A few customers mention that glossy finishes may show fingerprints more easily, but overall they find the case durable, protective, and great for daily wear.
